entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely awful cycling shoes I bought. They're complete garbage and I want my money back immediately.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

Are you kidding me? They're shoes! I put them on, went for one ride, and now I have massive blisters on both heels. I even tried adjusting the cleats thinking that was the problem, but no. They're just a terrible fit. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get the order number or the email address you used?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. I want a refund, not an excuse. If you can't do it, put your manager on the phone right now.

I understand, sir. One moment while I pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered 26 days ago. I can definitely help you with this, there's no need to speak with a manager.
Then do it! I swear, if you tell me I'm outside some ridiculous return window, I will light up every social media and review site on the internet about this.
Not at all, sir. According to our policy, standard items like these shoes have a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day 26, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. Well... good. It's about time. So what's next? You sending me a shipping label or what?

Yes, absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the shoes in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
And this is for a full refund, right? No hidden fees or garbage like that?
That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method. You'll see it processed within 3-5 business days after we receive the return. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just make sure that email shows up.
It's on its way now. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
